jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Come and push your journey to the next level!  At  Immense Group , we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about iGaming, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as the Site Reliability Engineer.  A taste of what you’ll do  The Site Reliability Engineer will be responsible for the technical design, planning, implementation, and the highest level of performance tuning and recovery procedures for mission critical systems. Other responsibilities include the troubleshooting of hardware, software, and networking issues, as well as ensuring that all computing operations run with optimal performance and security.   
 Ensure high availability and acceptable levels of performance of mission critical infrastructure resources. 
 Continuously analyse system performance and stability in production and proactively identify areas in need of optimisation. 
 Responsible for responding to support escalations. 
 Developing procedures to maintain security and protect systems from unauthorised use. 
 Developing procedures, programs and documentation for backup and restoration of host operating systems and host-based applications. 
 Developing and maintaining adequate system monitoring and alerting to maximise system uptime and minimise impacts on the end user experience. 
 Being responsible for owning and resolving escalated service issues. 
 Providing technical services and support for the following areas: 
 Internal systems, cloud, and network infrastructure. 
 Virtualization technologies: VMware, Proxmox, Microsoft, LXC. 
 Remote monitoring and management of system alerts and notifications. 
 
 
 Participating in the administration and maintenance of the remote monitoring and management system: update agent scripts, respond to alerts, monitor dashboards, and periodic system audits and review. 
 Participate in post incident reviews. 
 Any other task/responsibility which may be related and/or connected to the role of Site Reliability Engineer and/or DevOps Engineer. 
  Who and what we are after?  
 Proven experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps, System Administrator, or similar role for at least 3 years. 
 Working knowledge of Cloud environments and respective technologies (e.g. AWS, Oracle). 
 Experience with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL); proxies, networks (LAN, WAN); and patch management tools. 
 Proficiency with log management and visualisation (ELK stack). 
 Proficiency with monitoring solutions such as Prometheus and Grafana. 
 Proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab). 
 Proficiency with configuration management tools such as Terraform. 
 Proficiency with containerisation and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes, etc). 
 A working knowledge of server operating systems, particularly Linux and Windows. 
 Good knowledge on network protocols such as the HTTP and TCP stacks. 
 Knowledge of system security (e.g. intrusion detection systems) and data backup/recovery. 
 Ability to create scripts and automate processes using tools such as Rundeck, Ansible, Bash and Puppet. 
 Working experience using Nginx, PHP-FPM, SSL, DNS and Cloudflare are considered a plus. 
 A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline; professional certifications are considered as a plus. 
 Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. 
 Ability to work on own initiative, and as a team player. 
 Organised, patient and professional demeanour, with a can-do attitude. 
 Availability outside of working hours to resolve emergency issues promptly. 
  Employee benefits   Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year    Fresh and healthy Breakfast&Lunch prepared everyday in our penthouse kit

jobs.description:

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.   Job Title:  Platform Reliability Engineer  Location:  100% Remote (U.S.)  Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2  Salary Range:  $100,000–$150,000 Annually  Experience Required:  6+ years   Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.   Job Summary  We are seeking an experienced Platform Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 Five or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems. 
 Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling. 
 Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting. 
 Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads. 
 Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents. 
 Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications. 
 Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Wolt  
  At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.    The Data Developer Experience team is looking for a   Senior Software Engineer   to build core services for our Data Platform. The team builds the Data Control Plane, a Go-based internal Terraform- or Kubernetes-like platform which allows users and other services to configure and operate Data Platform infrastructure. 
 Our mission is to meet the massive data scaling needs of a global organization with a platform that is simple yet powerful, self-healing, agentic-safe, trustworthy, snappy, and cost efficient. 
  What you'll be doing  
 
  Designing  - you align our ambitions and stakeholder needs on a feature level. You collaborate with the team to propose well fitting solutions using RFCs. 
  Building  - you develop Go code with agents. The implementation may target a backend service, our plugin framework, CLI tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or even our React frontend app. 
  Documenting  - you ensure high quality, curated markdown documentation for users, AI agents, and maintainers / on-call. 
  Operating  - you strive for operational excellence with constant vigilance, proactivity, and on-call participation to ensure we provide a robust platform for business critical workloads. 
  Supporting  - you understand the needs of diverse data platform users and guide them to golden paths. 
 
  Our humble expectations  
 
 You have a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and/or platforms. 
 You bring deep experience with Go, but you possess a polyglot mindset and are happy to dive into Python or other languages when the problem calls for it. 
 You have hands-on experience building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines. 
 You possess a strong foundational understanding of networking and security best practices. 
 You are familiar with data platform architecture and technologies, specifically columnar databases/storage and MPP engines. 
 You are passionate about Developer Experience and excel at balancing user needs with technical and platform constraints. 
 You actively leverage agentic coding as your preferred workflow to accelerate value delivery, while maintaining the critical eye needed to rigorously vet and secure code for robust systems. 
 
  What's in it for you  
 
 A rare opportunity to join a near-greenfield project building state-of-the-art, robust, scalable foundations for the future. 
 Work in a Big Tech-adjacent environment with brilliant colleagues, modern tooling and practices, and large scale. 
 
       Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  
  We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.    Find  Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.    Job Title:  Cloud Systems Architect  Location:  100% Remote (U.S.)   Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2   Salary Range:  $100,000–$150,000 Annually   Experience Required:  6+ years    Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.    Job Summary   We are seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.    Required Qualifications:  
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.  
 Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.  
 Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.  
 Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.  
 Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.  
 Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.  
 Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.  
 Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.  
 Track record of leading architecture reviews and influencing engineering direction.  
 Cloud architecture certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  
  Preferred Qualifications:  
 Multiple cloud architecture certifications.  
 Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures.  
 Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
